text:
marina: Heads-up: planning a hotpatch slice release tonight 23:00 UTC. We'll swap engine kernel v7.3 -> v7.4-quant-optim and roll quant-v5 build. Need drain window and rollback criteria.

alex: +1. What's the change window? can we do 23:00-00:30 UTC quiet window?

marina: yes, quiet window 23:00-00:30 UTC. Deploybot run will be: `deploy-bot swap --bundle engine:v7.4-quant-optim --slice hotpatch --canary 3%`

deploy-bot: Scheduled swap at 2025-11-07T23:00:00Z, canary 3%, slice=hotpatch, pin=engine:v7.4-quant-optim-20251107

sam: QA smoke at 3% canary; telemetry checks: p95 latency, error-rate, kv-cache miss, matmul-ops variance.

guido: Add a regression threshold: if p95 increases >15% OR error-rate >0.5% in 10m -> auto-rollback.

marina: Also watch OOM and nvml thermal events. If node OOMs >2 or driver errors spike -> manual rollback.

sre-oncall: I'll monitor graphs, set alerts: p95_up +15, errors_alert >0.5, kv_miss +20%.

alex: For pinning: pin engine:v7.4-quant-optim-20251107 globally for 30m post-canary, TTL 2h if no issues.

marina: Release notes draft: https://docs.internal/release-notes/engine/20251107-hotpatch (please add QA signoffs)

sam: QA: running perf harness now. Quick log snippet:

```bash
# smoke checks
./smoke.sh --model gpt-mini --seq 512 --iters 100
# check for matmul mismatches in logs
grep -E "matmul|kvcache|oom" /var/log/engine/smoke.log
```

guido: Suggest also running quant bit-exactness test on 10 samples. If mismatch rate >0.1% -> hold.

marina: Ok. Rollback playbook: 1) pin previous engine:v7.3-20251001 2) drain new slice 3) roll traffic back 4) notify customers. I'll paste exact commands pre-made.

marina: Command dump for rollback:

```bash
deploy-bot pin engine:v7.3-20251001 --global
deploy-bot drain-slice hotpatch --grace 30s
deploy-bot shift-traffic --from hotpatch --to stable --percent 100
```

sre-oncall: Will open incident channel if automated rollback happens. @oncall will triage.

alex: All set. I will be available at 22:30 UTC for preflight. :thumbsup: 

marina: thanks team. final checklist: docs updated, release notes link, QA signoff, deploybot schedule. If no objections, we proceed.

guido: no objections. :shipit: 

marina: scheduling now.
